results.title: Senegal U17s make a statement with 9-0 rout of Cuba
results.content: Senegal made a commanding statement at the FIFA Under-17 World Cup, thrashing Cuba 9-0 to move to the top of Group F with four points. The result leaves them level with Croatia, whom they drew in their opening match.

results.title: Belgium: Workers march against spending cuts as living costs rise
results.content: Thousands marched through Brussels, on Monday 23 November 2026, against proposed austerity measures, with some clashes prompting police to deploy tear gas and water cannons. The protests came as Belgium's government struggled to agree on its budget for 2027.

results.title: Tensions in Libya and COP31 climate challenges [Africanews Today]
results.content: Tensions are rising in Libya following an attack on two vessels off the coast of Benghazi, including a Russian ship. results.title: US, Mexico, Jamaica and Costa Rica to co-host 2031 FIFA Women's World Cup
results.content: The United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica have been confirmed as hosts of the 2031 FIFA Women’s World Cup. The UK has been chosen to host the 2035 tournament.

results.title: Zambian opposition leader Mundubile formally indicted on treason charges
results.content: Zambian prosecutors on Monday formally indicted the country's main opposition leader on treason charges over an alleged plot to overthrow the government.

results.title: Investigation underway into cause of Zanzibar hotel blaze
results.content: Investigations continued Monday into the cause of a huge fire that engulfed six hotels along a popular beach in Tanzania ’s semiautonomous archipelago of Zanzibar. Several hotel workers were injured in the blaze over the weekend. Authorities said about 180 tourists were safely evacuated.

results.title: AI giant Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO after spy scandal
results.content: American AI chip giant Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive on Monday, less than two weeks after the co-founder resigned due to an alleged spy scandal.

results.title: Spanish authorities under pressure after record number of migrants reach Canaries
results.content: With a general election less than a week away, pressure is mounting on Spanish authorities over the growing number of migrant arrivals. More than 350 people in about six small boats reached the Canary Island's El Hierro on Sunday. That brings the total number of migrants being housed on the island

results.title: CAS to publish verdict on Senegal AFCON title appeal on Tuesday
results.content: The Court of Arbitration for Sport will publish its decision on the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations title on Tuesday, ten months after a chaotic final between Senegal and Morocco.

results.title: China: 5,000 drones illuminate sky over Three Gorges at autumn festival
results.content: Five thousand drones lit up the night sky over Wushan, southwest China, creating giant images of autumn leaves, mountains and river landscapes. The spectacular display celebrated the region's annual Red Leaf Festival.

results.title: Libyan naval forces remain on high alert after strike on Russian vessel in Benghazi
results.content: A military official says that naval forces in eastern Libya will remain on high alert to counter any threat after attacks targeted two vessels, including at least one Russian ship, off Benghazi. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Monday that Ukrainian forces were behind the strikes.

results.title: South African township turns discarded shipping container into community sensory therapy room
results.content: The initiative, run by non-profit organisation Afrika Tikkun in partnership with Sensory-Space, relies on recycled materials and community participation to provide accessible support where professional therapy services are limited.

results.title: China warns against turning Horn of Africa into geopolitical battleground
results.content: With tensions in the Middle East threatening peace in the Horn of Africa, China is warning against turning the region into a geopolitical battleground. Chinese envoys have visited Ethiopia, Djibouti, Egypt and Eritrea this month.

results.title: Cairo's honey festival showcases Egyptian honey bee industry
results.content: Egypt's capital welcomed the ninth edition of its annual honey festival between November 19 and 22.

results.title: Ukraine: Dramatic night rescue pulls woman from rubble after 22 hours
results.content: An elderly woman was rescued alive after spending 22 hours trapped beneath concrete slabs in Dymer, north of Kyiv. The death toll from Sunday's Russian strike on an apartment building has risen to 11.

results.title: COP31 ends without agreement as divisions deepen over fossil fuels
results.content: UN climate chief Simon Stiell expressed disappointment over the outcome, warning that the failure to secure agreement on key presidency-led decisions must not be repeated.

results.title: Tshisekedi and Ruto meet in Congo-Brazzaville to resolve DR Congo-Kenya rift
results.content: DRC President Félix Tshisekedi met his Kenyan counterpart William Ruto during a mini summit hosted in Congo-Brazzaville on Sunday. The two leaders pledged further relations after years of tensions over the DRC-Rwanda crisis.

results.title: Indonesia: Rescuers recover 24 body bags from burnt-out factory
results.content: A devastating fire has gutted a confectionery factory near Jakarta, with authorities recovering 24 body bags from the wreckage. Rescue workers continue searching for missing employees as investigators examine the cause.

results.title: UN calls for probe after drone attacks hit ships off Libya
results.content: There was no immediate claim of responsibility for either strike on Sunday off the port city of Benghazi, but they came as Ukrainian forces stepped up attacks against Russia far from the front lines.

results.title: Brazil: Colourful costumes and dancing take over Copacabana Pride
results.content: Thousands of people filled Copacabana's beachfront in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, on Sunday 22 November 2026, for the city's 31st Pride Parade, celebrating LGBT+ diversity and calling for greater equality.

results.title: Drone strikes hit homes and UN premises in Sudan's capital
results.content: The United Nations confirmed that one of its premises, with UN personnel inside, was damaged in the attacks. It condemned the risks posed to humanitarian workers in civilian areas.

results.title: Morocco: A surreal sculpture park turns the world upside down
results.content: An upside-down house, giant furniture and vegetable-headed figures await visitors at Ramakech, an 11-hectare sculpture park near Marrakech, where French artist Jean-François Fourtou brings childhood memories to life through extraordinary, larger-than-life installations.

results.title: Egypt record first win, Mozambique fall in Under-17 World Cup
results.content: Egypt and Mozambique are both second in their groups, each with three points. They will need wins in their final group matches to strengthen their chances of reaching the next round.

results.title: Muhoozi named man of the match after Uganda’s goalless draw
results.content: MuhUganda were held to a goalless draw by Ecuador in their second Group B match at the FIFA U-17 World Cup on Sunday, leaving the Cranes needing a win in their final group game to reach the round of 32.oozi named man of the match after Uganda’s goalless draw.

results.title: United Nations COP31 climate talks collapse in bitter row over fossil fuels
results.content: European nations, as well as many smaller climate-vulnerable countries rejected the draft deal which failed to mention fossil fuels.

results.title: West Bank: Four Palestinian villages targeted in suspected settler attacks
results.content: Burnt-out cars, damaged trucks and anti-Arab graffiti were discovered in four Palestinian villages in the Israeli-occupied West Bank on Sunday 22 November 2026, following overnight attacks blamed by local activists on Israeli settlers.

results.title: Drought strains Mauritius' agricultural sector pushing up food prices
results.content: El Nino-driven heat and the severe drought have slashed crop yields, raised irrigation costs, and sent food prices soaring.

results.title: Ex-opposition leader to stand as independent in Burundi's presidential poll
results.content: Agathon Rwasa was ousted as leader of the National Congress for Freedom party in March 2024 by dissident MPs.

results.title: Generations of Palestinians displaced by earlier conflicts live in limbo in Egypt
results.content: They face hurdles accessing education, healthcare, and other public services as they are considered foreigners.

results.title: African football reaffirms support for re-election of FIFA's Gianni Infantino
results.content: CAF has been consistently behind Gianni Infantino who is seeking a controversial fourth term to 2031, despite criticism of his leadership.
